content.short: Bode Li’l Goats is a multiplayer battle royale game on the #Cardano blockchain! Faíscas | Get your Li'l Goat and join to farm!
content.description:
Li’l Goats is a Battle Royale game where goats fight for survival in a 2D environment with a top-down view. Players can win tokens from battles, own arenas, and goats and contribute to the Li’l Goats universe and social and environmental causes.

The idea of using goats came from the fact that the game's creators are from the Northeast of Brazil, and the goat is a cultural symbol representing resilience in periods of drought. The concentration of poverty in Northeast Brazil is 47.9% of the entire country. Li’l Goats wants to bring hope to people in financial need, so 10% of all Li’l Goats annual revenue will go to charitable causes in Northeast Brazil.

The main goals of our project are to promote fair gameplay and, above all, a skill-based game; players must develop and use their strategies to win.
